name: SE Series Lead-Free Dual Wave Soldering System

items: Closed loop with inverter control system to keep the stability and accuracy of the conveyor speed
The assistant pressure device nearby the entrance to prevent the PCB from slipping
Spray nozzle driven by stepping motor to ensure uniform coating
Module design of spray fluxer system and the design of nozzle always perpendicular to rail, ensuring flux penetrates PCB easily
Forced air cooling system to attain the cool-down slope as per lead-free requirements
Standard with hot air heating for preheating zones
Module design suitable for SMT & THT component soldering
Exhaust adopts centrifugal fan with double filters to avoid any flux drop to PCB
The level of flux container is controlled by non-contact sensors to ensure no corrosion and longer life
Flux spray nozzle with self-cleaning system
Standard with air knives to prevent flux from expanding to preheat zone
Wave height control adopted with inverter, can be set individually
1/4HP high power mechanical pump to meet wave height as high as 15mm
Light & sound alarm, emergency stop, and over-load protection
